claim: INICON and MASTER are the CONWAY entry points the story ports.
MASTER is the per-call master control program of the Life process.
INICON starts by zeroing X and storing it to PHASE and CTEMP1 — the process begins in phase 0 at the playfield base.
INICON stores X=1 to CDONE — initialising starts the process (CDONE: 0 idle, 1 active).
INICON sets OBST high byte to $10: the sweep pointer starts at PLYFLD ($1000).
INICON sets TEMP2 low byte to $BE (high byte $0F): TEMP2 = $0FBE = OBST − $42, anchoring the 5x5 template window two columns and two rows behind the swept cell.
PHASE semantics: 0 is setup, 1..MAXPH−1 execute, MAXPH end.

source.verbatim: PHASE:	.BLKB 1			;0 IS SETUP 1 TO MAXPH-1 EXECUTE, MAXPH END

claim: CDONE semantics: 0 is idle, 1 is active.
MAXPH = 8 — the maximum number of growth tries.
EDGE = 2 — the count of mushrooms assumed touching on a screen edge.

source.verbatim: EDGE	=2			;NUMBER OF MUSHROOMS TOUCHED ON THE EDGE

claim: PLYFLD = $1000, 30 wide by 32 high — the field the sweep walks ($1000..$13BF, column stride $20).
DDT = $6E is the first of two stamps for the DDT bomb; CONWAY tests for DDT and DDT+1.

source.verbatim: DDT	=6E			;FIRST OF 2 STAMPS FOR DDT BOMB

claim: DEATHS = $71 — dying mushroom pictures ($71..$74).
GROWTH = $75 — growing mushroom pictures ($75..$77).
POISON = $78 — poisoned mushroom pictures ($78..$7B).
NORMAL = $7C — normal mushroom pictures ($7C..$7F, $7F fully grown).
MSKORA is 0 or $80 — the background bit CONWAY re-imposes as it rewrites cells.

source.verbatim: MSKORA:	.BLKB 1			;0 OR 80, IF WE PUT BACKGROUND BACK

claim: MASTER skips rows $1E/$1F (the score rows) — "REMOVE TOP TWO ROWS".
MASTER skips row 0 — the branch under "REMOVE BOTTOM TWO ROWS" fires for row < 1 only; row 1 is processed by GROWDIE/CLEANUP and gated out of STARTGR separately.
Upright (CKIND bit 7 clear): rows below 7 are the player area — MSKORA becomes $80 there.
Phase 0 masks the position with $0F — one MASTER call sweeps half a column (16 cells).

source.verbatim: AND #0F			;WE DO 1/2 COLUMN AT A TIME

claim: Non-zero phases mask with $1F — one MASTER call sweeps a full column (32 cells).
The sweep ends when OBST reaches $13C0 (PLYFLD/256+3 pages, low byte $C0) — end of the 30-column field.
One way to end: a finished sweep in a non-zero phase with NGROWN=0 jumps PHASE to MAXPH — "MUSHROOMS ALL GROWN".
When the incremented PHASE reaches MAXPH+1, CDONE is cleared — "TIMER RAN OUT, END CONWAY".

source.verbatim: STA CDONE		;TIMER RAN OUT, END CONWAY

claim: STARTGR leaves rows $1E/$1F alone (top row and scores).
STARTGR only proceeds for rows >= 2 (bottom row and message line left alone).
COLMAX defaults to $A0 — the template spans 5 columns x $20.
Column 0: the template scan starts at index $0A (third template column) — two columns fall off the screen edge.
On the extreme edge columns MSHTTL is seeded with EDGE — mushrooms assumed off-screen.
Column 1: the template scan starts at index 5 (second template column).
Column 29: COLMAX becomes $60 — only three template columns are scanned (plus the EDGE seed).
Column 28: COLMAX becomes $80 — four template columns are scanned.
GRCODE outer template row: corners are 2 (ignore), edge-adjacent cells are 1 (poison-forces-growth ring) — "ANOTHER FAIRY RING".
GRCODE middle row: the centre cell itself is 2 (ignored); the inner ring cells are 0 (straight Conway count).
A DDT bomb stamp (DDT or DDT+1) in the inner ring sets MSHTTL bit 7.
A poison mushroom in the inner ring ORs $20 into MSHTTL.
A cell >= DEATHS counts as a neighbour UNLESS it is exactly GROWTH ($75) — a mushroom freshly birthed by this same in-place sweep must not count.
A poison mushroom in a code-1 (outer ring) cell ORs $10 into MSHTTL — "GO TO GROWTH SETUP".
A blank never grows when the poison flag is set (MSHTTL & $7F >= $20).
A blank grows on a count of exactly 3, or on the forced-growth flag ($10) — "GROW ON 3 OR 10".
A birth is planted through MUSHE1 with the GROWTH picture.
A non-blank below NORMAL is left alone (letters in attract, poison mushrooms, in-progress stages).

source.verbatim: BCC 60$			;LEAVE IT ALONE (PROBABLY A LETTER IN ATTRACT)

claim: A normal mushroom beside a DDT bomb becomes POISON+3.
A normal mushroom with MSHTTL >= $20 (poison adjacency) dies.
A normal mushroom with the forced-growth flag ($10..$1F) grows.
A normal mushroom with zero neighbours dies.
A normal mushroom with 4 or more neighbours dies — survival is 1..3, NOT the classic Conway 2..3.
A fully-grown mushroom (NORMAL+3) that grows is left as-is.

source.verbatim: CMP #NORMAL+3		;REPLACE IT WITH THE EQUIVALENT GROWTH

claim: A damaged normal that grows maps via SEC SBC #NORMAL−1 (yields 1,2,3 with carry set)…
…then LSR / ADC #GROWTH — $7C,$7D -> GROWTH+1 and $7E -> GROWTH+2.
A dying normal maps to its equivalent death picture by subtracting NORMAL−DEATHS ($0B).
A store of POISON+3+$80 is suppressed — "NO POISON MUSHROOM IN PLAYER AREA".
GROWDIE selects only growth and death stages (DEATHS <= v < POISON).
A growth stage at POISON−1 completes to NORMAL+3 (fully grown) — without setting NGROWN.
A still-growing stage advances by 1 and stores the new value to NGROWN (activity marker).
A death stage at DEATHS calls MUSHDC (decrement mushroom count) and the cell dies totally to 0 — without setting NGROWN.
A still-dying stage decrements by 1 (and stores the new value to NGROWN).
CLEANUP runs when the player is prolonging the process (phase MAXPH).

source.verbatim: .SBTTL	END CONWAY IF PLAYER IS PROLONGING IT

claim: CLEANUP replaces growth stages with the shot-away NORMAL stages by adding NORMAL−GROWTH (7).
MUSHE1 is the entry MUSHER falls into with a caller-chosen picture in Y — CONWAY passes GROWTH.
MUSHE1 ORs the picture with the existing cell — "LEAVE GREY BACKGROUND IF ANY" (bit 7 preserved on a birth).

source.verbatim: ORA NY,OBST		;LEAVE GREY BACKGROUND IF ANY

claim: MUSHDC decrements the mushroom count — the count seam GROWDIE calls at total death (deferred to the ml3-3 mushroom-field reducers).
